headline: Log access needs attention
description: The collector cannot read the selected provider's local usage logs.

instructions.title: Review folder permissions
instructions.description: Open the permission settings for the provider log folder.

instructions.title: Allow read access for uToken
instructions.description: Usage metadata only; prompt and response content stay private.

instructions.title: Return and retry
instructions.description: Retry checks whether the log folder can be read again; no OS permissions are changed.
